## Practice Questions

- Question 1
Which of the following describes the core components that make up Dynamic HTML (DHTML)?
A) HTML + CSS + PHP
B) HTML + CSS + JavaScript
C) XML + JavaScript + AJAX
D) HTML + JavaScript + SQL

- Question 2
Where is the recommended location for including external JavaScript files in an HTML document?
A) Inside the body tag as the last element
B) Linked via a script tag in the head
C) Directly inside the title tag
D) Inside an image alt attribute

- Question 3
What will be the output of the JavaScript expression: alert("9" + 9);?
A) 18
B) 99
C) NaN
D) Error

- Question 4
Which DOM method is used to access a single HTML element via its unique ID attribute?
A) document.getElementsByName("some_id")
B) document.getElementsByTagName("some_id")
C) document.getElementById("some_id")
D) document.querySelectorByClass("some_id")

- Question 5
Which method of the window object is used to execute a function repeatedly at fixed time intervals?
A) setTimeout()
B) setInterval()
C) setTimer()
D) delayExecution()

---

## Answers & Explanations

- Question 1: B
  - Explanation: DHTML is defined as the combination of HTML (content), CSS (presentation/styling), and JavaScript (dynamic behavior).

- Question 2: B
  - Explanation: It is highly recommended to link external JavaScript files via a script tag in the head section, allowing the browser to cache the .js file.

- Question 3: B
  - Explanation: In JavaScript, the plus operator (+) performs string concatenation when one of the operands is a string, resulting in "99".

- Question 4: C
  - Explanation: The document.getElementById() method retrieves a single element based on its specific ID attribute value.

- Question 5: B
  - Explanation: setInterval() calls a function repeatedly at specified interval delays, whereas setTimeout() executes a function only once after a delay.
